title: Unit Event — Halt! Tenma's on the Case — Episode5 If I Had Been Faster

meta.Episode: Episode5 — If I Had Been Faster
meta.Event Outline: At Kijima's suggestion, Tsukasa has been putting on muscle to increase his acting chops. He and the others arrive at the Jidaigeki Studio Park with the Mikazukigumi troupe, but news of a theft puts the new production on hold...and that's when Tsukasa spots a suspicious ninja on the lot!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Luka and Emu have been gone for quite a while now. What do you think they're doing...?

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line: <Can you all guess where we are right now?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Where?
How do you expect us to...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I asked the operations staff and got special permission to climb up! This should make it a lot easier to find our ninja thief!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Right! Being able to see from up high should make things much easier... What a great idea!>

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: <And you're the best person for this since your vision's so good.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, I think I already see someone fitting the description you gave me.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Can you see him, Emu?
The ninja standing out in front of that soba shop.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Oh, I see a couple more outside the archery range and trick house!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can you guys go take a look?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Let's all work together to catch this ninja thief♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we'll go take a look!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can even ask everyone in Mikazukigumi for their help with this plan.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's contact Mr. Kijima and start looking together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(In front of the soba shop...
Oh, that must be him!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me!
Would you mind if I asked you a couple questions?

rows.Speaker: Ninja A
rows.Line:
Huh? Uh, sure.
How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Children in Ninja Outfits
rows.Line:
Eat my shuriken!!!
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!

rows.Speaker: Ninja A
rows.Line:
H-Hey, stop that!
Didn't I tell you not to throw those at anyone?! You almost hit this young lady!

rows.Speaker: Children in Ninja Outfits
rows.Line:
We're sorry.
But you should practice throwing these with us, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Ninja A
rows.Line:
Okay, okay! In a little bit!
Sorry, you wanted to ask me something...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I really doubt a busy dad like him is our thief...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Okay, I'm outside the archery range...
But I'm not seeing anyone dressed as a ninja...)

rows.Speaker: Ninja B
rows.Line: Trespasser! Do not think that you will be able to leave the ninja village alive! Take this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A smoke bomb...?!
No, it's only meant to look like one...!

rows.Speaker: Ninja B
rows.Line:
I am the shadow that protects this village!
And I shall fell all those who dare intrude!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I'm not seeing any scars on his right hand, so he must just be a regular cast member.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But his acting was superb!
He even produced that smoke at just the right time... I should stay and ask him more about his performance...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'm at the trick house...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now, where is he...?
If he went inside, that's going to complicate things...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Hm?!
Perfect! That one's walking right towards me!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Okay, I need to hear what he sounds like...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's suddenly antsy after taking one look at me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(He seems incredibly nervous...
On top of his voice becoming squeaky, he's begun sweating quite a bit.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He isn't carrying that pot with him, but I'm inclined to think...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This may sound like a strange question...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But would you mind showing me your right hand?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I finally found you, thief!!!!
Stop!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I should let Mr. Kijima and the others know... Alright, the chase is on!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Darn it...!
I should've grabbed his wrist or something first!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But compared to last time, the gap between us is smaller!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(And it's walled off up ahead!
That means I should be able to catch him!!!)

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Wow, cool.
It's like a real police chase.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Alright, just a little bit more to go...!
I'll chase him into that corner and...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's launching himself higher by kicking the wall...! This technique...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(That sound...
He must've landed on the other side of this wall and ran off...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Blast it...! I let him go again...!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(But I still wasn't able to catch him...
He was right in front of me, but I let him escape once more.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If only I could run a little faster...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If only I'd been able to perfect my wall jumping technique... Then I might've been able to catch him!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I saw you chasing after that ninja just now. I decided to run after the two of you...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But I guess I was too late. I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one apologizing...
I let him escape again...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Don't apologize!
I'm impressed that you got as close as you did.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Also, some of the troupe members should be searching on the other side of that wall. I'll let them know to keep me posted about any suspicious-looking ninjas.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
...
Is everything okay, Tenma? Are you hurt at all?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, no, I'm not hurt. It's just...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel so worthless right now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I let him escape not just once, but twice. I had him in my sights.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After doing all that training to become as agile as Heihachi too... Honestly, I'm such a...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You're coming with me! Right now!
